scope: Five bounded T09 guest predicates added after the existing sparse/rich detail and canonical door checks. Runtime evidence and admin coverage remain separate.
source_review_ruling: A simple rule applied to independently read public DOM facts may match the product's business rule without becoming a circular oracle. The link and image checks do not consume product functions or derived audit output. Complex readability count correctness is not claimed by the bounded predicate.

prepared_subtargets.oracle: Resolve href anchors in the owned public document; compare internal, external, and total displayed counts. Both zero requires the Links group to be absent.
Count live img elements and absent or blank alt attributes; compare Total, Missing alt, and group hint. Zero images requires the Images group to be absent.

Use the public body's rendered text with the same textContent availability fallback as capture. When text exists, require positive numeric displayed word and sentence fields, a numeric Flesch score, and a named standard band with grade. With no text, require the group to be absent and record this subtarget unverified.
prepared_subtargets.limit: This checks populated display and explanation only. It does not verify that word or sentence counts or the Flesch score were calculated from this page; metric value correctness remains unverified.

prepared_subtargets.oracle: Read the owned page's navigation entry and page response. Compare navigation type, exposed HTTP status and rounded duration exactly; check displayed transfer size against the measured bytes within its displayed precision. Absent timing values must remain omitted.

Read the public page's alternate links and JSON-LD/microdata types. Compare every rendered schema chip label, including plain text chips, and separately compare openable destinations. Use trusted pointer activation for one unique hreflang and schema link.
prepared_subtargets.limit: The door subtarget is recorded unverified when the public DOM lacks a unique hreflang link or a unique openable schema type from JSON-LD or microdata.

execution: Not run in this preparation lane; root owns the release preflight, resource guard, native browser run, and independent source/runtime review.
excluded: Save, history, clipboard, provider, Chat/Pilot, member authentication, and database writes
Full T09 or feature acceptance from these five predicates
Assumed Wikipedia metadata or browser timing where the live source is absent
